name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the meticulous world of supply chain management. He initially worked for a large logistics firm in São Paulo, optimizing delivery routes and inventory control. Recognizing the parallels between his skills and the demanding requirements of racing logistics, he aggressively pursued opportunities within the sport. After a brief stint volunteering at a local karting track, he landed an entry-level position at a smaller racing team. 

At Target Racing, Rafael applies his data-driven approach to streamline the movement of equipment and personnel, ensuring everything arrives precisely when and where it's needed. He's particularly adept at anticipating potential bottlenecks and proactively developing contingency plans. His distinctive trait is his relentless pursuit of efficiency, often challenging established procedures to identify areas for improvement, making him a valuable asset to the team.

Rafael is driven by a desire to see Target Racing perform at its best, and he believes that a well-oiled logistics operation is essential to achieving that goal. He's not afraid to challenge the status quo and is always looking for ways to improve the team's performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a custom-built spreadsheet for all logistical calculations.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
